verses.original: וְאֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֨ה אָמַ֜ר עֲלֵ֣ה אֶל־ יְהוָ֗ה אַתָּה֙ וְאַהֲרֹן֙ נָדָ֣ב וַאֲבִיה֔וּא וְשִׁבְעִ֖ים מִזִּקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶ֖ם מֵרָחֹֽק׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’el- mō·šeh ’ā·mar ‘ă·lêh ’el- Yah·weh ’at·tāh wə·’a·hă·rōn nā·ḏāḇ wa·’ă·ḇî·hū wə·šiḇ·‘îm miz·ziq·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·hiš·ta·ḥă·wî·ṯem mê·rā·ḥōq
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses Come up to the LORD you and Aaron Nadab and Abihu and seventy of Israel’s elders and you are to worship at a distance
verses.literalPt: Disse também Deus a Moisés: Sobe a Jeová, tu, e Arão, e Nadabe, e Abiú, e setenta anciãos de Israel; e adorai de longe.

verses.original: וְנִגַּ֨שׁ מֹשֶׁ֤ה לְבַדּוֹ֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה וְהֵ֖ם לֹ֣א יִגָּ֑שׁוּ וְהָעָ֕ם לֹ֥א יַעֲל֖וּ עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nig·gaš mō·šeh lə·ḇad·dōw ’el- Yah·weh wə·hêm lō yig·gā·šū wə·hā·‘ām lō ya·‘ă·lū ‘im·mōw
verses.literal: Moses alone . . . shall approach the LORD but the others must not come near And the people may not go up with him
verses.literalPt: Só Moisés se chegará a Jeová; mas os outros não se chegarão, nem o povo subirá com ele.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣א מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַיְסַפֵּ֤ר לָעָם֙ אֵ֚ת כָּל־ דִּבְרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־ הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֑ים וַיַּ֨עַן כָּל־ הָעָ֜ם ק֤וֹל אֶחָד֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה נַעֲשֶֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō mō·šeh way·sap·pêr lā·‘ām ’êṯ kāl- diḇ·rê Yah·weh wə·’êṯ kāl- ham·miš·pā·ṭîm way·ya·‘an kāl- hā·‘ām qō·wl ’e·ḥāḏ way·yō·mə·rū kāl- had·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer- dib·ber Yah·weh na·‘ă·śeh
verses.literal: When Moses came and told the people all the words and ordinances of the LORD they all responded with one . . . voice All the words that the LORD has spoken we will do
verses.literalPt: Veio Moisés e referiu ao povo todas as palavras de Jeová e todas as ordenações; todo o povo respondeu a uma voz: Faremos tudo o que Jeová tem dito.

verses.original: וַיִּכְתֹּ֣ב מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֵ֚ת כָּל־ דִּבְרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֣ם בַּבֹּ֔קֶר וַיִּ֥בֶן מִזְבֵּ֖חַ תַּ֣חַת הָהָ֑ר וּשְׁתֵּ֤ים עֶשְׂרֵה֙ מַצֵּבָ֔ה לִשְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḵ·tōḇ mō·šeh ’êṯ kāl- diḇ·rê Yah·weh way·yaš·kêm bab·bō·qer way·yi·ḇen miz·bê·aḥ ta·ḥaṯ hā·hār ū·šə·têm ‘eś·rêh maṣ·ṣê·ḇāh liš·nêm ‘ā·śār šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And Moses wrote down all the words of the LORD Early the next morning he got up and built an altar at the base of the mountain along with twelve . . . pillars for the twelve . . . tribes of Israel
verses.literalPt: Moisés escreveu todas as palavras de Jeová e, tendo se levantado de manhã cedo, erigiu um altar ao pé do monte e doze colunas segundo as doze tribos de Israel.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֗ח אֶֽת־ נַעֲרֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיַּֽעֲל֖וּ עֹלֹ֑ת וַֽיִּזְבְּח֞וּ זְבָחִ֧ים שְׁלָמִ֛ים לַיהוָ֖ה פָּרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ’eṯ- na·‘ă·rê bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·ya·‘ă·lū ‘ō·lōṯ way·yiz·bə·ḥū zə·ḇā·ḥîm šə·lā·mîm Yah·weh pā·rîm
verses.literal: Then he sent out some young men of Israel . . . and they offered burnt offerings and sacrificed young bulls as peace offerings to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Enviou mancebos dentre os filhos de Israel, os quais ofereceram holocaustos e sacrificaram a Jeová sacrifícios pacíficos de bois.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֤ח מֹשֶׁה֙ חֲצִ֣י הַדָּ֔ם וַיָּ֖שֶׂם בָּאַגָּנֹ֑ת וַחֲצִ֣י הַדָּ֔ם זָרַ֖ק עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ mō·šeh ḥă·ṣî had·dām way·yā·śem bā·’ag·gā·nōṯ wa·ḥă·ṣî had·dām zā·raq ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: Moses took half of the blood and put it in bowls and the other half . . . he splattered on the altar
verses.literalPt: Moisés tomou uma metade do sangue e pô-lo em bacias; e a outra metade aspergiu sobre o altar.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּח֙ סֵ֣פֶר הַבְּרִ֔ית וַיִּקְרָ֖א בְּאָזְנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה נַעֲשֶׂ֥ה וְנִשְׁמָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ sê·p̄er hab·bə·rîṯ way·yiq·rā bə·’ā·zə·nê hā·‘ām way·yō·mə·rū kōl ’ă·šer- dib·ber Yah·weh na·‘ă·śeh wə·niš·mā‘
verses.literal: Then he took the Book of the Covenant and read it . . . to the people who replied All that the LORD has spoken we will do and we will be obedient
verses.literalPt: Tomou o livro da aliança e leu, ouvindo-o o povo, o qual disse: Faremos tudo o que Jeová tem dito e seremos obedientes.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֤ח מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־ הַדָּ֔ם וַיִּזְרֹ֖ק עַל־ הָעָ֑ם וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הִנֵּ֤ה דַֽם־ הַבְּרִית֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר כָּרַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ עִמָּכֶ֔ם עַ֥ל כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ mō·šeh ’eṯ- had·dām way·yiz·rōq ‘al- hā·‘ām way·yō·mer hin·nêh ḏam- hab·bə·rîṯ ’ă·šer kā·raṯ Yah·weh ‘im·mā·ḵem ‘al kāl- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh
verses.literal: So Moses took the blood splattered it on the people and said This is the blood of the covenant that the LORD has made with you in accordance with all these words
verses.literalPt: Então, tomando Moisés o sangue, o aspergiu sobre o povo e disse: Eis o sangue da aliança que Jeová fez convosco sob todas estas condições.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַל מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְאַהֲרֹ֑ן נָדָב֙ וַאֲבִיה֔וּא וְשִׁבְעִ֖ים מִזִּקְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn nā·ḏāḇ wa·’ă·ḇî·hū wə·šiḇ·‘îm miz·ziq·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Then Moses went up with Aaron Nadab and Abihu and seventy of the elders of Israel
verses.literalPt: Subiram Moisés e Arão, e Nadabe, e Abiú, e setenta dos anciãos de Israel;

verses.original: וַיִּרְא֕וּ אֵ֖ת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְתַ֣חַת רַגְלָ֗יו כְּמַעֲשֵׂה֙ לִבְנַ֣ת הַסַּפִּ֔יר וּכְעֶ֥צֶם הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם לָטֹֽהַר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yir·’ū ’êṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl wə·ṯa·ḥaṯ raḡ·lāw kə·ma·‘ă·śêh liḇ·naṯ has·sap·pîr ū·ḵə·‘e·ṣem haš·šā·ma·yim lā·ṭō·har
verses.literal: and they saw the God of Israel Under His feet was a work like a pavement made of sapphire . . . as clear as the sky itself
verses.literalPt: viram ao Deus de Israel, e debaixo dos seus pés havia como uma obra de safira lúcida e como o próprio céu na sua claridade.

verses.original: וְאֶל־ אֲצִילֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹ֥א שָׁלַ֖ח יָד֑וֹ וַֽיֶּחֱזוּ֙ אֶת־ הָ֣אֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיֹּאכְל֖וּ וַיִּשְׁתּֽוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’el- ’ă·ṣî·lê bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lō šā·laḥ yā·ḏōw way·ye·ḥĕ·zū ’eṯ- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yō·ḵə·lū way·yiš·tū
verses.literal: But God did not lay His hand on the nobles of Israel they saw Him and they ate and drank
verses.literalPt: Sobre os nobres dos filhos de Israel Deus não estendeu a mão; eles viram a Deus, comeram e beberam.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה עֲלֵ֥ה אֵלַ֛י הָהָ֖רָה וֶהְיֵה־ שָׁ֑ם וְאֶתְּנָ֨ה לְךָ֜ אֶת־ לֻחֹ֣ת הָאֶ֗בֶן וְהַתּוֹרָה֙ וְהַמִּצְוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּתַ֖בְתִּי לְהוֹרֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh ‘ă·lêh ’ê·lay hā·hā·rāh weh·yêh- šām wə·’et·tə·nāh lə·ḵā ’eṯ- lu·ḥōṯ hā·’e·ḇen wə·hat·tō·w·rāh wə·ham·miṣ·wāh ’ă·šer kā·ṯaḇ·tî lə·hō·w·rō·ṯām
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses Come up to Me on the mountain and stay here so that I may give you the tablets of stone with the law and commandments I have written for their instruction
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés: Sobe a mim ao monte e deixa-te estar ali; dar-te-ei as tábuas de pedra e a lei e os mandamentos que tenho escrito, para que os ensines.

verses.original: וַיָּ֣קָם מֹשֶׁ֔ה וִיהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ מְשָׁרְת֑וֹ וַיַּ֥עַל מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־ הַ֥ר הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām mō·šeh wî·hō·wō·šu·a‘ mə·šā·rə·ṯōw way·ya·‘al mō·šeh ’el- har hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: So Moses set out with Joshua his attendant and went up . . . on the mountain of God
verses.literalPt: Levantou-se Moisés com Josué, seu servidor; e, subindo Moisés ao monte de Deus,

verses.original: וְאֶל־ הַזְּקֵנִ֤ים אָמַר֙ שְׁבוּ־ לָ֣נוּ בָזֶ֔ה עַ֥ד אֲשֶׁר־ נָשׁ֖וּב אֲלֵיכֶ֑ם וְהִנֵּ֨ה אַהֲרֹ֤ן וְחוּר֙ עִמָּכֶ֔ם מִי־ בַ֥עַל דְּבָרִ֖ים יִגַּ֥שׁ אֲלֵהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’el- haz·zə·qê·nîm ’ā·mar šə·ḇū- lā·nū ḇā·zeh ‘aḏ ’ă·šer- nā·šūḇ ’ă·lê·ḵem wə·hin·nêh ’a·hă·rōn wə·ḥūr ‘im·mā·ḵem mî- ḇa·‘al də·ḇā·rîm yig·gaš ’ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: And he said to the elders Wait here for us until we return to you Aaron and Hur are here with you Whoever . . . has a dispute can go to them
verses.literalPt: disse aos anciãos: Esperai-nos aqui, até que nos tornemos para vós. Eis que Arão e Hur ficam convosco; todo o que tiver uma questão chegue-se a eles.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַל מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־ הָהָ֑ר וַיְכַ֥ס הֶעָנָ֖ן אֶת־ הָהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al mō·šeh ’el- hā·hār way·ḵas he·‘ā·nān ’eṯ- hā·hār
verses.literal: When Moses . . . went up on the mountain the cloud covered it . . .
verses.literalPt: Moisés subiu o monte, e uma nuvem cobriu o monte.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכֹּ֤ן כְּבוֹד־ יְהוָה֙ עַל־ הַ֣ר סִינַ֔י וַיְכַסֵּ֥הוּ הֶעָנָ֖ן שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֑ים וַיִּקְרָ֧א אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֛ה בַּיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י מִתּ֥וֹךְ הֶעָנָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kōn kə·ḇō·wḏ- Yah·weh ‘al- har sî·nay way·ḵas·sê·hū he·‘ā·nān šê·šeṯ yā·mîm way·yiq·rā ’el- mō·šeh bay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î mit·tō·wḵ he·‘ā·nān
verses.literal: and the glory of the LORD settled on Mount Sinai For six days the cloud covered it and on the seventh day the LORD called to Moses from within the cloud
verses.literalPt: A glória de Jeová descansou sobre o monte de Sinai, e a nuvem o cobriu por seis dias; ao sétimo dia, do meio da nuvem, chamou a Moisés.

verses.original: וּמַרְאֵה֙ כְּב֣וֹד יְהוָ֔ה כְּאֵ֥שׁ אֹכֶ֖לֶת בְּרֹ֣אשׁ הָהָ֑ר לְעֵינֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mar·’êh kə·ḇō·wḏ Yah·weh kə·’êš ’ō·ḵe·leṯ bə·rōš hā·hār lə·‘ê·nê bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And the sight of the glory of the LORD was like a consuming fire on the mountaintop . . . in the eyes of the Israelites
verses.literalPt: Era a aparência da glória de Jeová como um fogo consumidor sobre o cume do monte aos olhos dos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֥א מֹשֶׁ֛ה בְּת֥וֹךְ הֶעָנָ֖ן וַיַּ֣עַל אֶל־ הָהָ֑ר וַיְהִ֤י מֹשֶׁה֙ בָּהָ֔ר אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם וְאַרְבָּעִ֖ים לָֽיְלָה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō mō·šeh bə·ṯō·wḵ he·‘ā·nān way·ya·‘al ’el- hā·hār way·hî mō·šeh bā·hār ’ar·bā·‘îm yō·wm wə·’ar·bā·‘îm lā·yə·lāh
verses.literal: Moses entered . . . the cloud as he went up on the mountain and he remained on the mountain forty days and forty nights
verses.literalPt: Tendo entrado Moisés pelo meio da nuvem, subiu o monte e lá ficou quarenta dias e quarenta noites.
